answer: Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The kernel panel is drawn blind, the ripple escrow settles at close, and oasis lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 7% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 308 account operation therefore ties up 14 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
